intro: Bronzebeard the Elder is a Lunar Festival encounter with Elder Bronzebeard within the dwarven mountain city of Ironforge. Honoring him during this ancestral celebration rewards travelers with wisdom and a token of his esteem. It reflects the deep reverence the folk of Khaz Modan hold for their forebears and long-lived heritage.

paras: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, friend, and offer you this token...
